{
  "phoneNote": "The receipt-style graphic gives the page an accounting identity, but repeated contact blocks and widely separated hero links make the phone page longer than necessary.",
  "desktopNote": "The typographic design feels professional, but oversized headings and uneven empty space weaken the desktop rhythm.",

    "impression": 4,

    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,

    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate the closing contact section and “Obiščite nas” into one block; leave only business identification and legal links in the footer.",
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline and oversized year, align the introduction columns, and tighten the mostly empty coverage and process sections.",
    "On phone, group the hero contact links into a compact row with one primary action, reducing the unused space before the receipt graphic."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On phone and desktop, the closing contact section is immediately followed by another address-and-directions block, then repeated phone and email details in the footer."
  ]
}
